name: Blackfriars Bridge
locality: City of London, London Borough of Southwark
type: arch bridge; road bridge; tram bridge; steel bridge
text: Blackfriars Bridge is a road and foot traffic bridge over the River Thames in London, between Waterloo Bridge and Blackfriars Railway Bridge, carrying the A201 road. The north end is in the City of London near the Inns of Court and Temple Church, along with Blackfriars station. The south end is in the London Borough of Southwark, near the Tate Modern art gallery and the Oxo Tower.

depictions.name: Blackfriars Bridge
depictions.text: Blackfriars Bridge is a bridge crossing the River Thames in London, England. Originally built in 1769, the bridge connects the districts of Southwark and the City of London, at Blackfriars station. It runs parallel with the Blackfriars railway bridge.
